evidence.decision: Chooses essential versus optional AR and estimated placement versus indefinite exact detection.
evidence.artifact: Produces placement, manipulation and recovery storyboard or implementation.
evidence.transformation: Furniture placement uses current estimates, gentle refinement and explicit post-call reset/cancel.
evidence.verification: Fails jumping/detached objects, false tracking confidence and endless recovery.
evidence.applicability: Separates phone AR from visionOS access model and real tracking/comfort from simulation.
evidence.handoffs: Gestures handles manipulation alternatives; Privacy handles camera/spatial access.
evidence.distinctiveness: Surface estimates, fixed product scale and relocalization make this more than an AR article summary.
